rows.text: 配备内燃机的意大利autoveicoli类别车辆，其排气系统须配备规定的消声器并保持有效、安装正确。替换件应适合车辆并符合适用要求；仅有兼容性不能保证合规。
evidence: CdS art.72(1)(b), (8)–(10), https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-72/ : silencing equipment and approval requirements; art.79(1),(4), https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-79/ : effective operation and correct installation, noise. Avoid inferring a universal replacement-specific type-approval mechanism.

evidence: CdS art.72(1)(b), (8)–(10), https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-72/ : silencing equipment and approval requirements; art.79(1),(4), https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-79/ : effective operation and correct installation, noise. rows.text: 车辆检验会检查排气系统的状况和工作情况，不会自动要求更换完好的消声器。
evidence: Direttiva 2014/45/UE, allegato I, punti 6.1.2 e 8.1.1, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A02014L0045-20230520: la revisione controlla perdite e difetti del silenziatore; non prescrive la sostituzione a ogni controllo.

rows.text: 供油系统将柴油从油箱送往喷射系统，并根据发动机需求管理供油。

rows.text: 题库判为FALSO：常见系统中，供油泵低压输送柴油，喷射泵再提高压力。但功能可以集成：某些喷射泵内含从油箱吸油的叶片泵。

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / collaboration /root/terra_author
issues: 29281 and 29282: The cited UN R59 replacement-silencer component approval covers M1/N1, whereas the learner text states an unrestricted approval requirement and the source bank includes heavy vehicles. Supply authority for applicable heavy categories or qualify the statement to the verified category/scope without inventing a universal rule. In 29281 compatibility alone does not guarantee all exhaust requirements; identify approval and correct fit without that guarantee.
reviewer_evidence: UN R59 https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2025/844/oj/eng is specific to M1/N1 replacement silencing systems. Bosch supply and injection roles are distinguished; integrated distributor feed requires keeping function separate from pump housing.

issues.reason: The printed source concerns replacement silencers generally, but the explanation and sole evidence only address UNECE R59 M1/N1; it leaves the question unresolved for heavy vehicle categories. CdS 72(1)(b),(8)-(10) and 79(1),(4) support broader equipment/conformity requirements but must not be presented as proof of every vehicle-type-specific approval detail.

Length is not a sufficient criterion generally, yet the only legal support and concrete instruction cover M1/N1. Explain the broader need for proper silencing, condition and installation using applicable authority without misapplying R59 to heavy vehicles.

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / collaboration /root/terra_author
issues: 29281: Article 72(1)(b) requires silencing and exhaust equipment only when the vehicle has a thermal engine. The learner text instead states all autoveicoli must have a silencer, which includes electric vehicles. Add the thermal-engine condition in all languages.
reviewer_evidence: CdS art.72(1)(b), https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-72/ explicitly conditions silencers on a thermal engine. Article 79 requires applicable equipment to remain efficient.
